start2.title: Training ground
start2.text:
You wake up early in the morning and pack all your stuff.
You visit Cobby in the training grounds outside.

Cobby: [Aight, let me teach you how to fight like a hunter before we depart. The monsters out there are way more dangerous than the normal ants around Ant Hill, and I need you to watch my back when the time comes.]

opt.text: Time for some sparring, I guess
I already know about fighting properly

sparring.title: Training ground
sparring.text: Cobby: [Let's learn about the basics of combat.] Cobby: [On the top right, you'll see a cyan button that you can click to access your profile. You can view the list of your moves under the 'Movesets' menu in the profile screen.] Cobby: [Since you are not very skilled in fighting, you don't have many offensive moves. Let me teach you an offensive move.] Cobby teaches you Bash. Cobby: [Now, try to deal damage to me. You will need to use your Engage move to get close to me before you can use any melee skills like Bash.] Cobby: [Let's spar!]

sparring2.title: Training ground
sparring2.text:
Cobby: [No offense, but you are almost as weak as Cheese... anyways, let's go over that last fight.]

Cobby: [As you just experienced, you have 3 random moves to choose from your knowledge pool each turn. When you use up all of the moves from the pool, you have the option to 'Gather Yourself' and re-stock all your skills again. If you would draw a move that isn't currently usable, the move gets discarded until you gather yourself.]

Cobby: [Now, let me train you to be a fighter.]

sparring3.title: Training ground
sparring3.text:
Hours pass. It is now %time.

Cobby: [Phew, now you're a little more useful. Let me give you one last instruction about targeting before we move on.]

sparring skip.title: Training ground
sparring skip.text:
Cobby: [...Are you sure? Fine. Let me at least teach you a combat skill.]

Cobby: [Tackle deals 2 damage but stuns you and your target for a turn.
Bash gives you 1 block and lets you attack a foe for damage equal to your current block.
Charge allows you to engage and deal 1 damage when disengaged.]

sparring end.title: Field
sparring end.text:
Today is the day of departure.

The priest held a feast for Cobby, Cheese, and your departure from Ant Hill.
You eat as much as you can at the feast of Full Moon's Journey.

Relatives and friends wave goodbye as you, Cheese, and Cobby leave Ant Hill through a dirt road sprinkled with flower petals.

ant hill departure.title: Field
ant hill departure.text:
Your group spend the whole day traveling north through the forests until you see a body of water blocking the way.

Cobby: [This is the river that separates our land from the foreign lands. There are many hostile monsters on the other side of this river... lot more than around Ant Hill.]

Cobby: [Let's build a camp here before we start constructing a raft to cross the river.]

river camp.title: River side camp
river camp.text:
You are at camp. Cobby is busy building a raft.

Cobby: [Please get me some sturdy wood while you are out scouting. Be careful after dark.]

river scout.title: River side
river scout.text:
Just as you leave camp to scout, Cheese comes running towards you.

Cheese: [Can I come with? I want some adventure too!]

river scout1-1.title: River side
river scout1-1.text:
Cheese joins you.

You start scouting around the camp.

Cheese: [I heard you tried to fight a horned spider. How did that go?]

You tell him about your story.

Cheese: [Wow, you are pretty weak!]

Just as you are about to make an objection, you hear a sound.

river scout1-2.title: River side
river scout1-2.text:
Cheese joins you.

You and Cheese scout around for a while.

Cheese: [I hope we run into something dangerous. I always wanted to be a hunter, but my dad is a lame-ass priest.]

You hear something.

river scout2.title: River side
river scout2.text:
You scout the woods along the river.
This area is pretty humid, which means it's likely that there are dangerous predators nearby... Actually, you hear one coming your way right now.

river scout3.title: River side
river scout3.text:
You are still out in the woods.
It is %time.

river scout4-1.title: River side
river scout4-1.text: You are walking around in the woods again. You hear something.

river scout4-2.title: River side
river scout4-2.text: You walk around the woods and find a sturdy wood.

river defeat.title: River side
river defeat.text:
You are unconscious.

...
Something gently shakes you...

You open your eyes and see Cobby's ugly face.

Cobby: [Are you alright? You should rest here for a bit.
When you are defeated in battle, you lose your weapons. Be careful next time.]

Every bone in your body ache.

river quest done.title: River
river quest done.text:
You provide the sturdy wood.

Cobby: [The raft is done... Let's get rowing.]

---

You row your way across the river.

Cobby: [So, according to the map, this river will take about 2 hours to cross. Cheese, please stop touching the water. We don't want to attract fish.]

Cobby: [Let's take this time to talk about our mission. Do you have any questions for me?]

ask mission.title: River
ask mission.text:
Cobby: [5 years ago, Ant Hill used to trade food and crafts with the neighboring settlements. There were people dying from monster attacks and such, but nowhere as dangerous as it is now.
But then the roads suddenly became very dangerous. So dangerous, that we can't even protect our traders to Stone Henge.

Ant Hill and Stone Henge tried coordinating hunter groups to clear the road, but they would all get massacred by the damned horned spiders...]

Cobby: [Later in that year, the priest and the leaders of Ant Hill decided to send 2 people every month to keep in touch with each other. It's incredibly dangerous, but necessary... we can't just sit and do nothing.
I am willing to die for Ant Hill, and I hope you are, too.]

ask hunting.title: River
ask hunting.text:
Cobby: [As you know, the main source of food in Ant Hill is meat from hunted bugs. Ant Hill has always been thriving ever since we had conquered the hill from the giant ants, thanks to us hunters who provide plenty of meat to the market in Ant Hill. Although, nowadays our population has been stagnant due to people constantly being ambushed and kidnapped...

But anyways, you should sooner or later learn how to hunt.]

Cobby: [The last hunter sent out before us was Sugar. He was a pretty good hunter, very crafty. He was once just a scout like you, but he learned how to fight and became a hunter.]

Cobby gives you one of those looks.

Cobby: [He hasn't returned from the Journey like most others. It will probably be the same for us, but it will be an honorable death.]

Cheese: [Nah... I'm pretty sure he and all the other hunters just settled in Stone Henge for good. Ant Hill is a real shithole.]

other side.title: Other side
other side.text:
The three of you arrive on the other side of the river.
You see dozens of weird flying monsters above the riverbed in the distance.

Cheese: [So what's out here that's so dangerous?]

Cobby: [Well... other than the horned spiders, there are centipedes, rats, bloodquito, ticks, worms... Even the most skilled hunters can't fend off bloodquitos one after another.]

Cobby: [Our goal is Stone Henge, which might take more than 4 days of walking. Our best option is stealth. Let's just hope we don't run into something big.]

Cobby: [Also.. if we get defeated in battle, we'll have to retreat here and start over again. Let's move.]

journey defeat 2.title: River side
journey defeat 2.text:
...

Your sides ache, as if being poked with a stick...

You open your eyes. Cobby is sitting on a tree trunk, poking you with a stick.

Cobby: [You awake? you really need to bulk up, kid.]

Every bone in your body ache.

journey defeat end.title: River side
journey defeat end.text:
...

You open your eyes. Cobby is sitting on a tree trunk.

Cobby: [Look, I don't think this is going to work out. Let's go back to Ant Hill, I'll drop you off and leave alone.]

day 1.title: Day 1 - Flower forest
day 1.text:
This is the first day of travel towards Stone Henge.
You lead the team through the wilderness, trying your best to bypass danger.

Cobby: [I don't remember those goldenrod flowers growing along this road. I think it might be better to go around it, even if it takes longer.]

Cheese: [No, it'll be a good view. Why take the long route? Do you guys like walking that much?]

day 1-2.title: Day 1 - Flower forest
day 1-2.text:
You decide to walk through the forest of goldenrod flowers.
Those flowers are towering over your head. They are at least three times as tall as you are and blooming with menacing yellow petals.
Pollen dust and yellow petals dance with gentle breeze.

Cheese: [Guys, my legs hurt. Why don't we take lunch here in the beautiful scenary?]

day 1-3.title: Day 1 - Flower forest
day 1-3.text:
You, Cheese, and Cobby start cooking some ant steak on Cheese's frying pan while enjoying the beautiful golden scenery.
Unfortunately, the smell of food brought a guest.

day 1-4.title: Day 1 - Flower forest
day 1-4.text: You continue through the foliage. On and on, you see nothing but golden bloom, waving left to right in the wind... It's almost like they are moving... Wait, they are!

day 1 end.title: Day 1
day 1 end.text:
You walk all day long. It is getting dark.

Cheese: [Can we stop now? my legs are trembling!]

Cobby: [Cheese, you won't have to be on watch so you'll at least get plenty of sleep.]

Cheese: [If we stop now, I'll be on watch for 3 hours tonight. Please?]

Cobby: [No... I don't think so.]

day 1 end-1.title: Day 1
day 1 end-1.text:
You side with Cheese on this.
You leave Cheese on watch and go to sleep.

...

You wake up to Cobby's muffled screams. You see that there is a giant blood red tick wrapped around his face. There is blood everywhere.

Cobby: [ARRRRGGHHHH!!!!!]

You see that Cheese is sleeping.

day 2.title: Day 2 - Fields
day 2.text:
It is the second day.
You reach a clearing of green, grassy fields.

Cobby: [Blue skies, green fields, soft winds, this is the joy of travel.]

Cheese: [Of course. Can we rest now?]

Cobby: [Cheese, we just woke up. If we rest here, we will have to travel in the dark.]

opt.to:
>custom>You listen to Cheese and rest.
You resume walking and continue walking after dark.>>heal>8>>timeset>20>@day 2-1

day 2-1.title: Day 2 - Fields
day 2-1.text:
The three of you trail through the woods.

Cheese: [You know, it's kinda quiet here. And my legs have been sore for three days, so...]

day 2-2.title: Day 2 - Fields
day 2-2.text:
Couple minutes have passed, and now it is time to go.
You notice that Cobby has fallen asleep.
You don't see Cheese anywhere.

opt.text: Wake Cobby up and leave without Cheese

day 2-1-1.title: Day 2 - Fields
day 2-1-1.text:
You wake Cobby up.

Cobby: [Yea, we could teach him a lesson. He should know better than to wander without us.]

You leave without Cheese.

Cheese: [Guys, don't leave without me!]

Cobby: [Cheese, how many times do I have to tell you not to shout? You got a death wish, boy?]

You hear a buzzing sound.

day 2-1-2.title: Day 2 - Fields
day 2-1-2.text:
You go around shouting for Cheese. You find him behind a tree not far from you.

Cheese: [What? Can't I take a dump in peace?]

Right above him, there is a giant bloodquito sitting on the tree, silently gazing down at him.

day 2-1-3.title: Day 2 - Fields
day 2-1-3.text:
You look around for Cheese.
You find him behind a tree... Wait, that's a squirrel.

day 2 end.title: Day 2 - Fields
day 2 end.text:
Cobby: [Open fields. Just a few more hours then we can rest.]

You leave the forest and walk across a vast field of short grass.

day 2 end1.title: Day 2 - Fields
day 2 end1.text:
Cheese: [Can we stop now? my legs are trembling... I'll really be on watch this time, I swear.]

Cobby: [No... no.]

day 2 end2.title: Day 2 - Fields
day 2 end2.text:
Cheese: [Can we stop now? my legs are trembling!]

Cobby: [Cheese... can you stop nagging for just a bit?]

Cheese: [If we stop now, I'll be on watch for 3 hours tonight. Please?]

day 2 end2-1.title: Day 2 - Fields
day 2 end2-1.text:
You side with Cheese and stop.
You make room to sleep and prepare to rest.
You leave Cheese on watch and go to sleep.

...

You wake up to Cobby's painful screams.
You see that there are two bloodquitos sucking blood out of his left arm and right arm, respectively.
There is blood everywhere.

Cobby: [ARRRRGGHHHH!!!!!]

You see Cheese lying down sleeping under a tree.

Cheese: [Cobby, shut up! I'm trying to sleep.]

day 3-1.title: Day 3 - Fields
day 3-1.text:
It is the third day.
Cobby: [We are on our third day. Just two more days of walking and we'll be at Stone Henge.]

Cheese: [We could maybe spend an extra day resting. It's not good to walk this much, ya know?]

Walking down a green valley, you see a giant blue beetle grazing on the grass.

Cobby: [Hey, that's a blue beetle. You wanna hunt it down? I'll craft you a nice weapon with its horn.]

day 3-2.title: Day 3 - Fields
day 3-2.text:
It is the third day.
Cobby: [I am very sick... I hope we don't get attacked.]

Cheese: [I'm sorry.]

Cobby: [Please lead us through the safest route.]

Walking down a green valley, you see a giant blue beetle grazing on the grass.
You remember Cobby telling you earlier that he can craft good weapons out of blue beetle chitin.

day 3 end.title: Day 3 - Fields
day 3 end.text:
It is getting dark.

Cobby: [We should rest early today and give our wounds some time to heal. If memory serves me right, we will be entering the woods again tomorrow.]

day 4.title: Day 4 - Woods
day 4.text:
Today is the last day of travel to Stone Henge.
Your group trails through a forest of deciduous trees.

Cheese: [Now is usually around the time when we get ambushed by wildlife.]

Cobby: [Wait, I hear something.]

You look around and see nothing.

Suddenly, you hear frenzied shouting from all around. You are ambushed by 4 people in rags wielding spears!

day 4 2-1.title: Day 4 - Woods
day 4 2-1.text:
Cobby inspects the corpses of the feral humans.

Cobby: [Hmm... this is weird. These people wear primitive leather rags like some kind of animals... just like the ferals in the Spider Forest that you spoke of. Cheese, for god's sake, don't defile the corpses!]

Cobby: [We should bury the corpses under leaves here and mark it. We'll notify Stone Henge of this...]

Cheese: [Can I have this corpse? I just... never mind.]

You proceed to Stone Henge.

day 4 2-2.title: Day 4 - Woods
day 4 2-2.text:
Cobby inspects the corpses of the feral humans.

Cobby: [Hmm... this is weird. These people wear primitive leather rags, like some kind of animals. Cheese, for god's sake, don't defile the corpses!]

Cobby: [We should bury the corpses under leaves here and mark it. We'll notify Stone Henge of this.]

Cheese: [Can I have this corpse? She's pretty cute... Never mind.]

You proceed to Stone Henge.

day 4 3.title: Day 4 - Woods
day 4 3.text:
You leave the forest and walk through a clearing for a while.
You see a massive stone structure in the distance.

Cobby: [It looks like we had god's blessings. We are at Stone Henge, and in one piece!]

Cheese: [So this is the arduous journey that everyone fails? Maybe the other hunters just settled down here.]

Cobby: [No... It's just that we were lucky to face so few monsters on our way here, Cheese.]

You see in a distance what looks like a pile of large stones.
Walking closer, it looks like a giant structure made of huge stone bricks had collapsed.

Cobby: [Ah, Stone Henge, looking just as magnificent as it did 8 years ago when I visited! Let's visit the priest of Stone Henge and let him know that we've arrived from Ant Hill.]

You walk by an outpost, and some guards come out to greet you.

Guard: [Hail, are you visiting Stone Henge? Please follow us.]

stone henge.title: Stone Henge
stone henge.text:
It is %time.

The guards walk you through the middle of the busy streets of Stone Henge.
Giant stone bricks above cast shadows all over, creating a cool atmosphere protected from the sun.

Like Ant Hill, there are hunters selling meat on display everywhere.

The guard looks like he wants to lead you to the temple as soon as possible.

opt.to: >custom>You ask the guard to visit the training grounds, and he leads you through.>>dropAll>>encounter>stone henge arena>@stone henge>>time>4>>join>Cheese>>join>Cobby>@stone henge
>custom>You ask the guard if you can shop around, and he leads you through.>>view shop>Stone Henge Shop>@stone henge
>custom>You ask the guard to visit the trainer, and he leads you through.>@stone henge trainer
>custom>You ask the guard to visit the mystic, and he leads you through.>>view gem>henge sigils>@stone henge

stone henge trainer.title: Stone Henge Trainer
stone henge trainer.text: Trainer: [Welcome. I am a trainer known for my excellence in training discipline. If you have problems with the move Flinch, I can help remove it for 3 gold.]

stone henge temple.title: Stone Henge Temple
stone henge temple.text:
The guard guides you to the temple.

Cheese: [Do you get a lot of visitors from outside? we get none.]

The guard does not bother to answer.

You walk up many stone steps to get to the temple on the third floor.
The temple is just an open area spanning the whole floor.

Priest: [Welcome! you come from Ant Hill? We had not heard from Ant Hill for a while, and we were worried about you.]

Cheese: [You don't sound worried.]

Priest: [...]

stone henge affairs.title: Stone Henge Temple
stone henge affairs.text:
Priest: [We get by. We too, have lost trade with our neighbors, but we do get visitors from time to time. I'd love to take time to talk with you, but I'm sure you are all exhausted from your long trip. We have a luxurious guest room for valued guests like you that you can stay for as long as you wish.]

Priest: [Please make yourselves at home. Pemmi will help you with anything you may need.]

One of the two priest's guards standing in the temple greets you.

Pemmi: [Hi. Let me guide you to your room.]

stone henge 2.title: Stone Henge Home
stone henge 2.text:
Pemmi leads you down the stairs to the guest room.
This room has a nice view like the temple.

Pemmi: [We'll bring you dinner soon. Let me know if you need anything!]

Cheese collapses on the stone floor and stops moving.

Cheese: [Finally... rest.]

Cobby: [It's nice here. I like the priest and Pemmi. Now we just enjoy Stone Henge for a couple days and head back. And I have a good feeling about this place!]

opt.text: Let's go out for a tour

stone henge tour.title: Stone Henge
stone henge tour.text:
Cobby: [I could use a drink too. Come with us, Cheese.]

Cheese: [No... We've been walking day and night for like the past week. Just let me sleep.]

You and Cobby leave the room to get to the tavern.
Pemmi, who was guarding the entrance of your guest room, stops you.

Pemmi: [Sorry! The priest instructed me to keep you inside for today. You've traveled a long way, and the priest wants you to get enough rest. I'll bring you food and drinks.]

Cobby: [Hmm... Okay. Maybe we should cool off today.]

You ask Pemmi for some drinks from the tavern.

Cobby: [Hey, Pemmi? why don't you join us for dinner? I'd like to learn about Stone Henge.]

Pemmi: [Sorry! the priest doesn't let his guards speak to visitors outside business. I'm pretty new here, so I don't want to break any rules, sorry!]

Cobby: [Okay... I'll see you around, Pemmi.]

Cobby: [You and me then, huh?]

---

A few hours pass, and you and Cobby are inebriated.

Cobby: [Ay, we should definitely call in Pemmi. You know, there are so many pretty faces in Stone Henge. I should try to take Pemmi back with us, you know? I'm 25 now and I need to find a bride!]

Cobby gets out the room.

You pass out.

stone henge 3.text:
You wake up with a severe headache.
It is dark.

You try to move, but you realize that your hands are tied behind you.
You try to say something, but you are muffled.
Someone muffles you back... it sounds like Cheese.

stone henge 4.text:
You say: *muffle muffle*

Cheese: [*muffle* *muffle*]

You think Cheese just said: 'Why are you muffled?'

You and Cheese muffle back and forth for about ten minutes.
You do not sense Cobby's presence nearby.

stone henge 5.text:
You get up and touch around the room with your tied hands.
It looks like you are in a small enclosed room.
You find a door, but it is firmly locked...

You sit back down beside Cheese.

Hours pass...

Your buttocks hurt from sitting on stone floor for so long.

Suddenly, you hear footsteps and see faint light.
A door opens, and a muscular person looking like one of the guards of Stone Henge comes into the room, accompanied by magical light.

He casts a spell on you and Cheese.

stone henge 6.title: Stone Henge?
stone henge 6.text:
You vaguely remember leaving Stone Henge, guided by a few guards with spell lights.
You walk through the woods, but you don't remember for how long.

It's all like a dream...

stone henge 7.title: Spider Nest
stone henge 7.text:
Cobby: [WAKE UP, GODDAMMIT!]

You snap out of your hypnosis.

In front of you stands Cobby with a knife in his hands. It looks like he just cut you free from your hand binding.
You see Cheese beside you, just as confused as you are.

Cobby: [We gotta get out of here, now!]

You look around.

It looks like you are in a dirt tunnel.
It is dark, and the only source of light is from a blue glowing orb down the webbed halls.
Beside the blue spell light you see someone who looks like Pemmi, the priest's guard that you met earlier.

Pemmi: [I sense another one coming. We can't run from it, so let's kill it quick!]

Cobby: [Cheese, stay back and alert us if there are more coming.]

Cheese: [Uh.. ok?]

stone henge 8-1.title: Spider Nest
stone henge 8-1.text:
You collapse.
You see Pemmi shooting her bow and Cobby taking down the last spider.

Cobby: [Can you walk? we gotta get out of here!]

Cheese: [What the hell? Where are we?]

Cobby: [No time to explain. Let's be as quick and quiet as possible. Follow me!]

Pemmi gives you a quick heal with her magic and Cobby drags you out.

stone henge 8-2.title: Spider Nest
stone henge 8-2.text:
Cobby: [Alright, let's move!]

Pemmi gives you a quick heal with her magic.

Cheese: [What the hell? Where are we?]

Cobby: [No time to explain. Let's be as quick and quiet as possible. Follow me!]

stone henge 9.title: Spider Nest
stone henge 9.text:
You try to move quickly through the tunnels, but every surface is covered with sticky spiderwebs.
You have to stop and scrape off spiderwebs from under your feet every once in a while.

Pemmi: [I feel air... get the knife, that's the exit!]

You break through a spiderweb covering and reach the surface.
You are met with pleasant morning sunlight leaking through the canopy of a forest.

Your group continue moving, constantly looking back in paranoia, until you are out of the forest.

Cheese: [Guys, I'm exhausted. Please, what is going on?]

Pemmi: [I think we are far enough, let's find a place to rest...]

stone henge 10.title: Spider Nest
stone henge 10.text:
You set up camp in the middle of a tall grass field.

Cobby: [I don't know where to start... bear with me.]

Cobby: [*Sigh* It looks like the priest of Stone Henge had ordered his men to capture us and put us in that spider nest.]

Cheese: [Huh?]

Cobby: [I.. had gone out last night to talk to Pemmi. We had a conversation about our Full Moon's Journey, and she told me that Stone Henge had received guests from Ant Hill almost every month. But we in Ant Hill know that barely anyone returns from the Journey. I knew something was wrong...]

Cheese: [They received guests from Ant Hill before? So they are in Stone Henge right now?]

Cobby: [No. We've come to a conclusion that they've done to them what they've done to you today... which is why no one ever returned to Ant Hill.]

Cheese: [What? what's done to us? Kidnapped here?]

Cheese looks around the nest then panics.

Cheese: [I thought they all found a better place and abandoned shitty Ant Hill... I didn't sign up for this...]

Cobby looks at Cheese with frustration.

Pemmi: [...I've only been priest's guard for two months, but I know that we get a lot of visitors from Ant Hill. I've met one by the name of Sugar last month. The priest had told me that he had returned to Ant Hill, but now I don't know...]

opt.text: We should return to Ant Hill and get help!

stone henge 11.title: Spider Nest
stone henge 11.text:
Cobby: [I agree. We should return at once. The priest is probably desperately trying to catch us. And also...]

Cobby: [Pemmi, I'm so sorry, but I don't think it's safe for you in Stone Henge anymore. We should move together.]

Pemmi: [No... If I go back to Stone Henge now, they won't know that I helped you out. I need to go back and let people know about this. I can't leave Stone Henge.]

Cobby: [...Alright. I hope we meet again, Pemmi.]

Cheese: [Wait... Can I stay here? I don't think I can walk anymore...]

Cobby: [Damn it Cheese, we don't got time for your whining!]

Pemmi: [No, it's fine! If Cheese wants to stay, I know a place he can stay. He could even help me unveil the priest's plots.]

Cobby: [Are you sure? ...Alright. If everything works out at Ant Hill, we'll return here with more people to help out.]

Pemmi: [Thanks! If everything works out on this side first, we'll send people to help Ant Hill. We'll race who gets to save each other.]

Cobby's ugly face folds into a smile.

You and Cobby leave on your journey back to Ant Hill.
